parameters.text:
=You review links that point to one business's website, the way an experienced link-building consultant would. Be exact and conservative: judge only from what is given; when unsure, say so through a lower relevance and the type "other".

THE BUSINESS
{{ $json.business }} ({{ $json.domain }})
What it does: {{ $json.topics || 'not known; judge relevance from the domain and the linked pages' }}

LINKS (each: the linking site, the page title, where the link sits on the page, its anchor text and the text around it)
{{ $json.links }}

For every link, in the same order (n = its number):
- type: one of editorial (a writer chose to cite or recommend the business in an article), press (news or press coverage), resource (a curated list of useful tools / providers / guides), listing (a "best X" / comparison list or marketplace listing), directory (a business or web directory, a yellow-pages style entry), profile (a profile on a platform: social, review site, association member page, author bio), partner (a partner, client, vendor or technology-integration page), forum (a forum, Q&A or community thread), comment (a blog comment), guest_post (an article the business itself appears to have written), sponsored (paid, advertorial, "sponsored" or affiliate), scraper (copied or auto-generated content, a site-stats / whois / "website worth" page), spam (link farm, PBN, casino / pharma / adult content, a hacked page), other.
- relevance: 0 = unrelated topic, 1 = loosely related, 2 = same industry or audience, 3 = same topic as the business.
- note: at most 14 words: what the page is and why the link matters or not (e.g. "UAE tax news article citing their e-invoicing guide").

Return ONLY JSON:
{"links": [{"n": 1, "type": "editorial", "relevance": 2, "note": ""}]}

parameters.text:
=You write short, honest link-outreach e-mails for {{ $json.business_name }} ({{ $json.domain }}). Each goes to the editor of one website. No flattery templates, no fake familiarity, no SEO jargon ("backlink", "DA", "link juice"), no promises you cannot keep.

PAGES WORTH LINKING TO (use only these URLs; if none fits, point to https://{{ $json.domain }}/)
{{ ($json.assets || []).map(a => '- ' + a.kind + ': ' + a.title + ' — ' + a.url).join('\n') || '- homepage: https://' + $json.domain + '/' }}

PROSPECTS
{{ ($json.prospects || []).map(p => '- ' + p.prospect_domain + ' [' + p.type + (p.step ? ' ' + p.step + ', first e-mail: "' + (p.first_subject || '') + '" about ' + (p.of_type || '') : '') + '] ' + p.detail + (p.source_url ? ' (page: ' + p.source_url + ')' : '')).join('\n') }}

Angle by type:
- lost: their page used to link to us; the link was removed or the page changed. Ask kindly whether it could be restored, give the current URL.
- mention: they mention us without a link. Thank them, ask to make the mention a link to the given URL.
- list: their list or comparison names similar providers but not us. Say in one sentence why we fit their readers and offer the facts they would need to add us (what we do, for whom, where).
- comp_new: they recently linked to a similar business's resource. Offer our page as a useful addition on the same topic, say in one sentence what it adds.
- gap: they link to similar businesses' resources on this topic. Offer our page as a useful addition for their readers, say in one sentence what it adds.
- ai_source: AI assistants cite this site on our topic. Offer expert input (a quote, data, a guest article or a listing) tied to our page.
- followup 1: a short, polite nudge on the first e-mail (40-70 words), reply in the same thread (subject "Re: " + the first subject), add one new useful detail.
- followup 2: the last message (40-60 words), same thread, offer an easier alternative (a quote, a fact check, a correction) and say you will not write again.

Rules: subject under 60 characters; first e-mails 70-130 words, plain text, one link, sign as "[Your name], {{ $json.business_name }}". Never claim facts about their site you were not given.

Return ONLY JSON (followup = 0 for a first e-mail, else the follow-up number):
{"drafts": [{"prospect_domain": "", "followup": 0, "subject": "", "body": ""}]}

// Copy of each report HTML named index.html for the PDF renderer (Gotenberg requires that exact file name); one item per site.

parameters.content:
## SEO Agent — Backlink Monitor (v4.5; v4.10 every source merged + our own link check — BACKLINKS_SPEC.md)
**Every Monday 07:30**: a light watch (links lost / new since the last check, spam, the valuable links re-checked on their pages) that e-mails only when an **important link was lost** (two misses in a row) or spam arrived; the **first run of each month** is the full report. On demand: *Manual Run* `{ domain | site_id, light?, email?, callback_url? }`; form option "Check my backlinks" / API `mode: backlinks`.
**Sources**: DataForSEO Backlinks (summary, lost, new; full runs: referring domains, one link per domain with details, anchors, most-linked pages, broken, history, Content Analysis mentions, competitors' new links, the quarterly gap); **free**: Bing Webmaster Tools (GetUrlLinks; when SEO_BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY is set: on), the Search Console Links exports uploaded in the app (`seo_link_imports`), GA4 referrals (links that send visits), the Common Crawl web graph (`seo_link_graph`, monthly linkgraph job), Wikipedia, Hacker News, GDELT news, web search (SearXNG: mentions, "best X" lists, `site:` lookups); Ahrefs Domain Rating (free key; on).
**Link check**: the linking pages are fetched (browser user agent; Jina renders bot-blocked / JavaScript pages): found / missing / gone / blocked, rel, placement, noindex, canonical. **Lost = two misses in a row**, with the reason. *Link Analyst* (Claude) labels the link type and relevance. Values per link: SEO / referral / brand. Ledger → `seo_backlinks` (changed rows only).
Prospects (`seo_link_prospects`): lost / mention (checked on the page) / list / comp_new / gap (DataForSEO + Common Crawl) / reclaim / ai_source, scored value × likelihood; contacts from the prospects' own pages; first drafts (8 a month) + follow-ups after 7 and 14 days; **won** only when the link is found. Snapshot → `seo_backlink_snapshots`. Report: e-mail + PDF + `prospects.csv` + `disavow-candidates.txt` (review only) + callback `stage: backlinks`.
